# Extra Alpine packages preinstalled in the dsh-go iSH rootfs.
#
# Format: one package per line, `name` or pinned `name=version`.
# Pinned versions are verified against the live APKINDEX at build time:
# if a pinned version is gone from the repo, the build fails loudly
# (update the pin). Dependencies are resolved from the live index and
# recorded in rootfs-packages.lock.
#
# What ships (and why):
#   bash       — the sandbox shell (the DSH "bash" tool runs /bin/bash;
#                the base image only has busybox ash)
#   python3    — Python 3.12, the scripting runtime
#   py3-pip    — pip, so the agent can install Python packages
#   ripgrep    — `rg`, required by the DSH agent's file search (glob/grep)
#   curl       — standard HTTP client (base image only has busybox wget)
#   nodejs     — Node.js 22 (the DSH engine runtime; also what `node` is)
#   npm        — npm 10 (ships separately from nodejs in Alpine)
#   pnpm       — pnpm 9, fast disk-efficient package manager
#   git        — git, version control
#
# Deliberately NOT included (install on demand with `apk add`):
#   build-base (compiler) — kept out to keep the image small.
#   bun — NOT available as an apk in Alpine 3.21 (no `bun` package in
#   main or community); install it separately if needed (official
#   aarch64 binary from bun.sh, or `npm i -g bun` once npm is present).
bash=5.2.37-r0
python3=3.12.16-r0
py3-pip=24.3.1-r0
ripgrep=14.1.1-r0
curl=8.14.1-r3
nodejs=22.23.5-r0
npm=10.9.1-r0
pnpm=9.15.9-r0
git=2.47.3-r0
